subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: James Porter <james.porter@acmehealth.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:24:00 -0800
Subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification

Hi James / Lina,

Great to meet today — thanks for taking the time to walk through Acme Health's use case. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Summary of call: Acme will evaluate Redwood for inference hosting for clinical NLP and patient-facing assistant features. Primary concerns: PHI handling, SOC 2 evidence, data residency, and procurement timelines.
- Key stakeholders you mentioned: James (Security lead), Lina (Head of Product), Procurement (procurement@acmehealth.com). Please confirm if there is an economic buyer we should loop in (CPO / VP Product / IT Ops).
- Proposed scope for security review: API endpoints used for inference, model artifacts storage, log retention/audit logs, and customer-managed key options.

Action items / next steps:
1) I attached the initial security questionnaire (security-questionnaire.pdf) — please fill out the questions about data types and systems in scope and return to us.
2) James / Lina: can you confirm the systems in scope (API only vs. API + batch data pipelines + S3 buckets)? A short list is fine.
3) Procurement contact: please share any standard MSA/PO process or timing expectations.
4) Neha (cc'd) from our Security team will be the primary RM for the review; she'll kick off the intake once we receive the completed questionnaire.

Tentative timeline: we can complete the kickoff and initial intake this week and target a SOC2/evidence review next week if your procurement timeline aligns.

Thanks — I’ll follow up in 48 hours if I haven’t heard back.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: security-questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 8 pages)

From: James Porter <james.porter@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & scope clarification

Marissa — thanks for the recap. Quick answers inline:

- Systems in scope: initially API endpoints (real-time inference) + S3 buckets where model outputs are archived. We also have a scheduled batch pipeline that writes anonymized summaries to an internal data lake (not PII), we can exclude that for the first pass if that helps speed things up.
- Economic buyer: Lina indicated budget sits with VP Product (Brian Chu) and final sign-off goes through Procurement. I can loop Brian into the thread if helpful.
- Procurement: procurement@acmehealth.com handles MSAs; typical cycle is 3–4 weeks but we have some flexibility for pilots.

I attached our current SOC 2 report for context.

James
James Porter
Security Lead, Acme Health

Attachment: acme-soc2-cert.pdf (PDF, 12 pages)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: James Porter <james.porter@acmehealth.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & scope clarification

Thanks James — that's super helpful.

Based on this, proposed immediate scope:
- In-scope: Real-time inference API, model artifacts storage (S3), audit logs for inference requests.
- Out of scope for initial review: batch pipelines and internal analytics buckets (we can add those in a later phase).

Next asks from our side:
1) Please complete the attached questionnaire (security-questionnaire.pdf) and highlight any items where Acme requires additional controls or documentation.
2) Can you confirm whether Brian Chu (VP Product) should be included in procurement conversations now or after an initial pilot?
3) Timeline: if we get the questionnaire back early next week, Neha will schedule a kickoff sync (30–45m) and share the specific list of evidence artifacts we’ll need.

I’ve also attached a short note outlining the Redwood systems we expect to be in scope for the review to make the questionnaire easier (redwood-systems-in-scope.md).

If it helps, I can schedule a 30m intake call with Neha and your team — propose Tue 11/17 or Wed 11/18 morning PST.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: redwood-systems-in-scope.md (text)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Security review kickoff & scope clarification — intake prep

Neha / Sean — forwarding the thread from Acme. Highlights:
- In-scope: Real-time API + S3 artifacts + audit logs.
- External provided SOC2 cert.
- Procurement cycle ~3–4 weeks; economic buyer likely VP Product (Brian Chu).

Can you please: 
1) Neha — review their SOC2 and the attached questionnaire; flag any items that need follow-up (esp. KMS/HSM, data residency, PII handling).
2) Sean — can you prepare the systems-in-scope summary and a short list of evidence (audit logs, retention policy, KMS whitepaper) we can hand to them in the kickoff? I started redwood-systems-in-scope.md but please expand as needed.

I'll tentatively propose Tue 11/17 10:00am PST for the intake call; if that works for you I’ll send an invite and include James and Lina.

Thanks — Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
